answer: Jury traffic forced through a canyon: one checkpoint where an auditor sees every voter. Each identity mines a 250-credit compute bond per epoch for a vote slot — non-transferable, no clone inherits it. The bond is the signal; each fake mints a fresh kernel, so k clones burn 250k up front. Cap reward at 300 credits per identity: a 1,000-strong fleet spends 250,000 chasing 300,000 shared with all voters, so every marginal clone earns below its fee, and cost scales linearly. Expired bonds fund the next audit round.
